name: Custom Login
description: Starter gear and reputation on first login.
notes: wow-manage.sh registers this in SQL_MOD_REGISTRY as install_type conf_module, but it is a C++ module (clone into modules/, rebuild). A legacy modules/custom-login dir (no mod- prefix) breaks the build because AzerothCore derives Add<dirname>Scripts() from the directory name; the script renames it at startup (1233-1247).
